critical_code_review_comments: PWAManager.js line 68: setUpdateReg(e.detail) — when index.js dispatches, detail is the registration object (registration itself, not {waiting}). handleUpdate reads reg?.waiting/installing which works for real SW flow. Consistent.
handleUpdate sets window.__PWA_UPDATE_ACCEPTED__=true BEFORE choosing worker/reload path — correct so that controllerchange reload does not fire prematurely on first install.
Install dismiss window is 7 days — reasonable. Consider also honoring the dismiss when the beforeinstallprompt fires later in same session (currently correctly gated by dismissedUntil check).
In onBeforeInstall the event is stored in state even when dismissed — good, allows immediate prompt if user clears dismiss without needing another OS event.
seed_data_creation: None. Used synthetic beforeinstallprompt and CustomEvent('pwa-update-available') via page.evaluate.
